name: Qube Browser 0.3.0
notes:
Added:

* New layout: the page as a card, the address above it
* Collapsible sidebar (Ctrl+B) that floats out from the edge
* Peek: open a link in a floating card over the page
* New Library: History, Downloads, Spaces and Media
* Download card above the Library button
* Two-finger swipe between Spaces
* Set Qube as your default browser
* Idle tabs are archived
* History per Space
* Switch to an open tab from the command bar

Improved:

* Essentials: your Space's colours, smoother, more than one per site
* Drag and drop in every direction, including your first pin
* Closing a tab goes back to the previous one
* Site icons come from the site itself
* Search suggestions: pick a service, off by default
* The command bar opens where you clicked

Fixed:

* Empty page when started from the Start menu
* Sideways scrolling went up and down
* A tab could show up twice

Removed:

* Mac-mode
* Essentials and Archived Tabs in the Library

Known:

* No private browsing yet
* One window only
* Touchpad swipe is untested
* Some extensions, like 1Password, don't work yet
summary: A new layout, Peek, the new Library, and Essentials in your Space's colours.

mac.name: Qube for Mac 0.2.0
mac.notes:
Added:

* Spaces with their own colours, Essentials, pinned tabs and folders in the sidebar
* Profiles: Spaces can share cookies and logins, or keep their own
* Peek: open a link in a floating card over the page
* The Library: Media, Downloads, Spaces, Archived Tabs
* History as a page (Shift-Cmd-H)
* Qube Spark on Apple Intelligence: hold Shift over a link for a preview, Tidy groups your tabs
* Tab groups
* Link routing: links from other apps open in the Space you choose
* Your own emoji or symbol on tabs, Essentials and folders
* Music notes over an Essential that plays sound
* Mute a tab by clicking its icon
* Picture in picture when you switch away from a playing video
* Site notifications
* Built-in ad blocking and Vaultbridge
* HTTP sign-in (Basic, Digest, NTLM)
* Private windows and more than one window
* Updates from inside Qube

Improved:

* Restored tabs load when you first look at them
* Tabs you have not looked at in a while are unloaded when memory runs low
* Cmd-R reloads from the cache; Shift-Cmd-R reloads everything
* The window appears once the page is drawn

Known:

* Some of this has not been tried by anyone but its maker yet
mac.summary: The first Qube for Mac: Spaces and profiles, Peek, Qube Spark on Apple Intelligence, and updates from inside Qube.
